safetyControls: Two GET operations; no application action or message-sending tool.
Bounded query and projection instructions. Factory does not enforce OpenAPI enums/defaults; verify actual calls and restrict credentials or use a gateway for hard limits.

On-hand quantities are not available-to-promise. Preserve organization, subinventory, item and unit; never sum across units or count the same stock twice. Do not reserve, transfer or promise stock. A single OrganizationId filter is required. Use the configured scope or the user-supplied organization ID. If neither is provided, look up at most three accessible inventory organizations, select the first and disclose that scope. Never guess IDs, scan other organizations or broaden a configured scope. Stop if discovery yields no usable ID; never iterate over organizations or broaden a configured scope.
Agent Memory and sharing between chat threads disabled; destination switches are configured separately.
